hypotheses.justification: The local lemma not_dvd_of_coprime derives hpm : ¬ p ∣ m from hmp and [Fact p.Prime]. Thus m ≠ 0, since every natural number divides 0 (Nat.dvd_zero), and Nat.pos_of_ne_zero recovers hm. Insert this derivation after defining hpm; the remaining proof is unchanged. The excluded case m = 0 is therefore impossible under the remaining hypotheses.
